test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 23 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate adjective to fill in the blank.

Jack always looks handsome, even if he is a ________ out of style.
solution:
The correct answer is '**little**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The adjective "**little**" is used to indicate a small degree or amount.
 
• In the given sentence, "**little**" correctly describes Jack being slightly out of style.
 
• **Options 2, 3**, and 4 are grammatically incorrect in this context.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

**Complete Sentence:** *"Jack always looks handsome, even if he is a **little**__ out of style."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 2: "more little"** is incorrect because "more" cannot modify "little" in this context.
 
• **Option 3: "less"** is incorrect because it does not fit the grammatical structure of the sentence.
 
• **Option 4: "least"** is incorrect as it conveys the wrong meaning in the given context.
